FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: AutoZone Parts & Accessories specializes in retailing a wide range of automotive parts and accessories, catering to both professional repair shops and individual consumers. Our operations involve the procurement and distribution of high-quality parts and accessories for various vehicle makes and models. We prioritize safety and regulatory compliance, operating from secure and well-maintained facilities that adhere to all local, state, and federal regulations. Our inventory management systems ensure efficient stock management, minimizing stockouts and overstocking. We emphasize employee safety training aligned with OSHA standards to foster a safe working environment. Our facilities implement documented fire protection measures, including automatic sprinkler systems and approved fire extinguishers, particularly in areas dealing with flammable materials. With a focus on customer service, our knowledgeable staff members provide expert assistance to help customers find the right products for their automotive needs.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: AutoZone Auto Repair & Services, LLC, 9876 Repair Way, Memphis, TN 38103-4502, specializes in mechanical repairs and diagnostics for a variety of vehicles.
